title: cr-sqlmap-rl
_comment: Set id's username per account (withthecodebeone / minhart). The kernel dir must also contain circuit_breakers.py, fa2rnn.py, eval.py. Add RELAY_URL + RELAY_API_KEY as Kaggle Secrets on the kernel (Add-ons > Secrets). enable_internet=true is required so the kernel can reach the ngrok relay.
